from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Identified parties involved in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role (e.g., Appellant, Respondent)")

class FeeDetail(BaseModel):
    """Specific court fee details."""
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., Second Instance Case Fee)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Total fee amount")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Party responsible for payment")
    split_amount: float | None = Field(description="Specific share of the fee")

class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """The final disposition of the case."""
    ruling: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the ruling (e.g., Dismiss Appeal, Maintain Original)")
    details: str | None = Field(description="Additional context or specific legal action")

class MonetaryCompensation(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary awards or returns."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of monetary action (e.g., Compensation, Return, Fine)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Monetary amount")
    recipient: str | None = Field(description="Receiver of the funds")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Payer of the funds")
    items: list[str] | None = Field(description="Physical items or specific funds associated")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    """Official case identification number."""
    number: str | None = Field(description="The court case number")
    court: str | None = Field(description="Court that issued the number")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information for a single document."""
    parties: list[Party]
    fees: list[FeeDetail]
    outcomes: list[JudgmentOutcome]
    compensations: list[MonetaryCompensation]
    case_numbers: list[CaseNumber]
